rational_curve: E_t: y^2=x^3+t*x+1, Q=(0,1), integral short Weierstrass model; rational kQ coordinate height is max(abs(numerator(x)),sqrt(denominator(x))) in reduced x=a/b^2, recorded outside arm timers
target_law: for each frozen curve and scalar k ascending, construct reduced public T=k*Qbar outside timers; lift arm receives only T coordinates; record known rational kQ height separately and do not pass it to the lift arm
lift_law: reuse pinned public-coordinate lift search: x=a/b^2,y=c/b^3, increasing H=max(abs(a),b), then b,a; modular x filter, coprime a,b, exact integral square, first full public-point match
arm_order: for odd k lift then rho; for even k rho then lift
measurement_boundary: ordinary-host diagnostic, setup and fixture construction excluded; all target-dependent lift attempts charged to that point, same-point rho through scalar verification; rational lift and verified scalar are distinct outputs
claim_boundary: exact finite small-scalar height ladder on four selected curves, with complete capped rows and separate known-rational-height comparison
